Sasha: Quick check — bump window for API/runtime/console/SDK is tomorrow morning. Cutoff is 10:00 PT. Any last-minute breaking changes?
Alex: API side: no breaking changes, just docs + minor header tweak. I'll tag `api/v1.12.0` after CI.
Maria: Runtime: I have a small perf tweak (KV cache behavior) that I want to ship but it touches hot path. Opening PR in ~40m. If it doesn't land, we should still proceed.
Diego: Console: UI changelog updated, no infra changes. SDKs already have compat tests passing.
Chandra: FYI console/SDK branches are on `release/1.12.x` — will mirror tags once API tag exists.
Alex: Bump script I'll run:```./scripts/bump-version.sh api 1.12.0
git push origin api-v1.12.0```
Maria: If runtime needs to be reverted, we'll fallback to `runtime-v1.11.3-compat` (already built).
ci-bot: build/api #432 passed — all checks green. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: build/runtime #789 running (ETA ~20m).
Sasha: Plan: freeze non-critical merges at 09:30 PT, final tag + release notes by 10:00 PT. If you need an exception ping me or add a comment here.
Diego: Changelog snippet for runtime I pushed: `- runtime: reduce KV cache memory for small keys (PR #1024)` — can someone confirm wording?
Alex: wording LGTM. Minor nit: add `(opt-in)` if it's behind flag.
Maria: it's behind `--kv-new` flag, will update entry.
Chandra: For branch coordination: please create hotfix branches as `hotfix/<repo>/v1.12.1` if needed. We'll backport from main -> release/1.12.x.
Sasha: Good call. Also reminder: update the release-matrix doc (internal) with new versions after tagging. I'll handle matrix + announce channel once tags done.
release-bot: Reminder set for 2025-11-16 09:30 PT — freeze window starting in 30m.
Alex: I'm available to tag and push the API artifacts. If runtime is delayed, we can still tag API+console+SDK and ship runtime as a follow-up patch.
Maria: OK opening a PR with the perf change now, will link here when ready.
Diego: If anyone needs me to cut a preliminary tag for the console to test downstream integrators, I can do a `console/v1.12.0-rc1`.
Sasha: Thanks everyone. Let's update this thread when PRs land so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:
